descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S09 「数量和长度：未完成任务数 0 / 1 / 12，以及医院查房前里任务出现在第 1,200 个字符之后」 Counts and length: open-task count 0 / 1 / 12, and a Hospital pre-round whose tasks come after character 1,200

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th …（UAT TC-22 step 1；TFA-92588 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). …（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given C0: no open tasks; C1: 'Follow up BMP' only; C12: twelve open tasks; L1: a Hospital patient with no tasks and a 1,213-character pre-round narrative followed by the three UAT tasks

When C rows: Save & Extract with 'BMP came back, creatinine 1.1. PT saw her, walking with a walker.' in both contexts. L1: the Hospital pre-round harvest with the client's own 1,200-character cut

Then C0: nothing added. C1: BMP closes, nothing added. C12: BMP and PT close, the other ten stay open, nothing added or duplicated. L1: the three tasks appear, one each

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U2/U4 per row; U3 for C12 (each pattern matches exactly one task). L1: U1 sets no length limit; the runner sends the first 1,200 characters exactly as usePreRoundProcess.ts does, so on main L1 is expected to Fail (a finding against U1). Nursing Home pre-round makes no tasks on main (Q3), so L1 is Hospital only. C1/C12 carry the UAT known gap on the BMP closure (Q7)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
